copy.lede: James and the team at J Curtis & Sons build patios, driveways, paths, fencing and whole new gardens. Customers talk about dream gardens finished start to finish, a 33 square metre path done quickly and tidily, and James being organised throughout.
copy.about_alt: A new Indian sandstone patio with curved edging, laid by J Curtis & Sons
